contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_books_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `books` BEGIN DELETE FROM `books_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_books_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `books` BEGIN DELETE FROM `books_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_books_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `books` BEGIN INSERT INTO `books_fts`(`docid`, `title`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_books_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `books` BEGIN INSERT INTO `books_fts`(`docid`, `title`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`); END
